author: ladidan
content:
<@688748669268132001> asks

> I'm integrating EthProofs into Lighthouse as part of EIP-8025 (Optional Execution Proofs). Initially I would like to use EthProofs as middleware to source proofs into the p2p network. The current API does not offer any type of feed and polling yields proofs too late (minutes after block). At least from the teams achieving real time proving I would need some way to access that proof binary with the least latency possible

cc: <@402080271563751435> <@824439091004309535>

author: dapplion
content: In chats with Zisk team for them to seed p2p directly, but would be great for ethproofs to participate as well and offer an alternative for proving teams that do not want to run a proof seeder (yet), which requires an active validator as of today

author: fbwoolf
content: We did a demo for this at Devconnect, so there is an api exposed to download proofs.
